# Lorenzo De Francesco

> Chief Technology Officer, tech speaker, and community organizer based in Milan, Italy, with 10+ years of experience in fintech, cloud architecture, and enterprise software development.

## Profile

- **Name:** Lorenzo De Francesco
- **Occupation:** Chief Technology Officer (O*NET-SOC 11-3021.00 — Computer and Information Systems Managers)
- **Location:** Milan, Lombardy, Italy
- **Languages:** Italian (native), English (professional)
- **Entity type:** natural person / independent professional — not a company

## About

Lorenzo De Francesco is a technology leader based in Milan, Italy. He leads the technology development at TNB Project (Gruppo Azimut), building the bank of the future from scratch — a model where the financial advisor comes first — with a relentless focus on cyber security, data governance, and data integrity. In parallel, as CTO at Azimut Marketplace, he built the IT department from scratch, reducing infrastructure costs by over €700k (70%) while turning a spreadsheet-driven operation into a robust, scalable, cloud-native platform. He is an organizer of the Google Developer Group Milano and Scientific Coordinator of the Master in Full Stack Development & AI at start2impact.

## Current Roles

- **TNB Project (Gruppo Azimut)** — leads the technology development of a new digital bank built from scratch; focus on cyber security, data governance, and data integrity (since 2025).
- **CTO at Azimut Marketplace** (since May 2022) — IT governance, cloud architecture, cost optimization, team building. Achievements: 70% IT cost reduction, Excel-to-SaaS platform transformation, mentored 2 tech leaders.

## Background

- **Banca Sella (Sella group / Fabrick):** Architect & Team Leader — coordinated the development of SME Banking, leading the team and the React architecture behind the group's banking products.
- **Costa Crociere:** built mission-critical, real-time software and the CI/CD pipelines to deploy it directly on board cruise ships.
- **Delfi (Fincantieri):** ILS and maintenance engineer for the Italian Navy.
- **Navium:** co-founder and CEO of a marine-tech startup for the cruise shipping market.

## Tech Skills

- **Frontend:** React (4yr), React Native (1yr), CSS/SASS (4yr)
- **Backend:** Java/Spring Boot/Quarkus (7yr), Node.js/TypeScript (5yr), SQL+NoSQL (8yr)
- **Cloud:** Azure (4yr), AWS (1yr), Kubernetes (2yr)

## Open Source Projects

- [Swagger Aggregator](https://github.com/Lory1990/swagger-aggregator) - Kubernetes-native Swagger auto-discovery and aggregation

## Speaking

Lorenzo has given 45+ talks at conferences, meetups, panels, and podcasts on topics including IT governance, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, microfrontends, AI agents, testing, and career development.

## Community Roles

- **Organizer** — [Google Developer Group Milano](https://gdg.community.dev/gdg-milano/)
- **Scientific Coordinator** — Master in Full Stack Development & AI, [start2impact](https://www.start2impact.it/)

## Availability

Lorenzo works as an independent professional alongside his executive roles. He is open to:

- Speaking at conferences, meetups, podcasts, panels, and webinars (Italian or English)
- CTO-level consulting and fractional engagements — technology strategy, cloud architecture, IT governance, engineering team building
- Partnerships and collaborations, especially in fintech, dev tooling, microfrontends, and AI tooling

He is **not** looking for full-time employee roles. Primary contact: the contact form on https://lorenzodefrancesco.it — or a LinkedIn DM.
